# Thunderstruck

Thunderstruck is Sky Stinger's older sister, a background Pegasus filly in the G4 television continuity of *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic*. She is the purple pony near the sandbox in his childhood flashback.

[![Sky Stinger's family, including Thunderstruck by the fence — Friendship is Magic, Hasbro Studios (2016)](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/18/1373831/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/1373831)

- **Appearance:** Lavender-purple coat, swept dark blue mane and tail with a yellow mane streak, aqua eyes, and a lightning-cloud cutie mark. Her lanky filly design resembles young Fluttershy. [Foal character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals)
- **Name:** Thunderstruck is an established fandom label, documented in the image archive by July 2020; no official name or original naming event was verified. The character herself appears in the official show. [Fan identification discussion](https://www.reddit.com/r/mylittlepony/comments/1rk7yah/who_is_this/)
- **Speaking status:** No individual dialogue or voice actor verified. No alternate identity or further episode, film or comic appearance verified.
- **Family:** One of Sky Stinger's four sisters; the fandom catalog identifies her as his older sister. [Sky Stinger's family listing](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sky_Stinger)

## Important moments

- **A crowded childhood — Top Bolt (S6E24, October 15, 2016):** She appears among Sky's siblings while Vapor Trail explains how hard it was for him to attract his parents' attention, providing context for Vapor's decision to secretly boost his flying. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165215/s06-e24-top-bolt) (timestamp unavailable); [episode transcript](https://transcripts.foreverdreaming.org/viewtopic.php?p=188230).

Only one meaningful scene could be verified; she has no independently established character arc. No reliably attributed solo fan art was verified. The wiki listings were available through indexed excerpts, but direct retrieval was blocked.
